review_description: The process was extremely simple and the team is very friendly.  I got a couple of quotes and these guys met my needs the best.  Would highly recommend them.
Seamless installation, easy to deal with, very  helpful, and super efficient.

AC Electrical was recommended by Solarquotes. I found Aaron very good to deal with, supplied a very detailed and competitive quote.For our usage profile, very low, we decided on a 3kw system. This system in quote gave a payback period of 3.5 years.The installation was clean and efficient, including an upgrade of switchboard. The installers were very professional and friendly. All install requirements to grid carried out very efficiently, making the process enjoyable.The initial out showed a rapid oscillating, which was reported to Aaron,  who contacted Goodwe support, who carried an online update to tune to grid. Output is now steady.After 10days in autumn we appear on track to achieve payback in 2.5 years. I was skeptical solar would be economic for our usage, but at this stage appears I have been proved wrong.I recommend AC Electrical
Great installation and quality of the installation.The salesman was not pushy like the rest.They gave me enough information to make an informed decision.

Aaron has been awesome since first contact before installation.it’s been 3 years since installation and we changed internet provider. The system showed an abnornmal connection. Arron come and updated the inverter.

Aaron was great to deal with; it was good to talk to the guy who was actually going to be doing the installation.After a couple of site visits and several quotes later, he managed to design an awesome system; exactly what we were after.Everything was taken care of. From the distributed power application, right down to configuring the iSolarcloud app once the installations was finished.It was great to see that a switchboard upgrade (including a changeover switch), consumptions monitoring, and general electrical inspection was part of the package.The only regret so far was not going with a bigger battery right from the start (we ended up adding extra modules to max out the battery later on).
Very helpful. Great experience with Aaron and his team. Highly recommend
